role: source-qualified descriptive concentration and fixed-mass contrast comparison
scope: Figure 12 a/b only; low-pressure observations reused from Figure 3
source: Moroney et al. (2015), DOI 10.1016/j.ces.2015.06.003, printed page 233, PDF index 17
rights: New attributable numerical redraw; restricted PDF and source renders excluded from Git; no blanket licence asserted.

encodings.columns: pot and filter exit, separate observables
encodings.top: native centers, blue circles 2.3 bar labelled, red squares 9.0 bar labelled; lines explicitly declared piecewise-linear representation
encodings.bottom: central interpolant difference on common components; discrete graphical sensitivity bars at 50/100/200/400/600/800/900 g, never a continuous ribbon
encodings.sign: red interval: NEGATIVE; purple interval: SIGN_UNRESOLVED
encodings.support: No extrapolation or connections across gaps. All actual components are gap-free; signed tails and zero axes visible.

ceiling: 90 plotted markers, not 90 physical extractions. Source-conditioned observational differences only; no experimental confidence, causal pressure effect, practical equivalence, kinetics independence or physical validation.
